text: This little machine very much exceeded my expectations!!! Holds alot more than I thought, can do all of a sheet set, queen sized, 5-6 sets of nursing scrubs.  It is an aggressive little machine, it will clean your items VERY WELL!.  Long sleeve tee shirts get tangled very easily and tend to really get get stretched out, keep them away from pants and wash them in small batches to keep their shape.  Spin dryer is AMAZING!!!!!!  LIGHT WEIGHT!  I pick it up and place in bath tub and remove shower head and hook up filling hose there and drain in the tub! Great product for the price! I pd $160.

Was a bit nervous when purchasing this, as some reviewers complained of leaking and other problems, but I'm very satisfied! It's the perfect size for my tiny apartment and washes the perfect amount of clothes per load. I was actually pleasantly surprised by how dry the spinner gets the clothes. Unless it's heavy material like jeans or thick blankets, most items come out very lightly damp.
I think some people can be quite rough with the machine, so it's important to remember that--to give the machine a long life span--you shouldn't overload it, or run more than a couple loads at a time. Only use one side at at time too. Just try to treat it well and it'll work out fine. I've had mine for several months and the only thing I could possibly complain about it that the filling hose attachment got a bit loose on the the faucet end, but that was easily fixed by placing a small rubber band around it. Overall, I'd highly recommend this machine to anyone living in a small space in need of a washer.

This is life-changing for apartment dwellers who have to schlep up and down stairs to the basement laundry room. I had my first load in it within minutes of unpacking it. It's very easy to use, and it holds a load about half the size of a regular washer. It did a flannel king-sized sheet and a few pillow cases with no problem. Another load was 5 normal weight towels. Another was 2 pairs of chinos and 4 yoga pants. You put in your clothes, fill it with water and add detergent and set the wash cycle; come back and drain; refill and run again to rinse and drain; transfer to the spin side, and in 5 minutes they come out drier any regular washer I have used. I also purchased a Panda dryer, and my sheets and towels dried in 30 minutes or less. With coin-operated machines costing about $10 a week, I'll be saving money after 11 months.

This Panda xpb45 replaced a 3.6 cubic foot American made top-loader that cracked the outer tub during repetitive power failures and started leaking. The machine was only 4 1/2 years old. The Panda has surprised us by creating really dirty, opaque, wash water on the first loads we ran. I thought at first that it was really dirty clothes, but when I washed a load of unworn "clean" shirts from the closet, the wash water was still grey and dirty looking. After 3 or 4 times through the wash cycle without changing detergents or spot treatments the wash water looks like one would expect, a little dirty (brownish), but not opaque.

The Panda lets me soak a load overnight if necessary or convenient. Its' predecessor would automatically drain after 3 or 4 hours in a soak cycle unless it was unplugged from the wall. I used to pretreat even small bloodstains with hydrogen peroxide to remove them. With the new machine, unless it is a large bloodstain, it washes out without pre-treatment.

Washing is now a manual process which requires minor thought. I actually have to remember whether it just finished a wash cycle or a soak cycle. The spin-rinse tub works surprisingly well, I always liked the spin-rinses that the washers of the 60's had. I know it is not intended, but a spin-rinse on clothes with hanger dust on them is usually enough to run them through dryer and wear them. We may save enough money from the shorter time that the electric dryer runs
Only lasted 3 months and won't work again! I shouldn't have bought this unit. I could have save by going to my usual Laundry services near my home.

We bought this Panda for our youngest daughter as a Christmas gift,  to use in her apartment.  She HATES the laundromat.  She had suggested another brand, but it had very poor reviews and poor peformance.  Most of the reviews for this brand were positive, so we took the plunge and purchased the Panda.  It is a bit bigger than anyone of us expected, but it's really cute for what it is.  Our daughter used it for the first time tonight and said it washed her jeans so wonderfully, and spins them almost dry.  Be informed, the spinner is NOT a dryer, as stated in the product details. It is a spinner.  I suggest you buy 3 extra items when you purchase the Panda:  (1) a clip and drip laundry hanger for the delicates.  This item hangs from a sturdy shower rod.  (2)  A mesh bag for the delicates and socks to wash in, or they will be tangled and knotted.  (3) a metal clothes drying rack ( I purchased one from Wal-Mart for around $20).  Our daughter drained her washer into the bathtub.  She recommends putting a thick plush rug under the washer to help muffle the noise. She said the residents just below her can probably hear the washer, and she will likely just run the washer during the daytime.  She is extremely satisfied with this portable washing  machine.

I bought this unit for regular washing between trips to the laundromat. I wish the the filling and rinsing were a little less manual for me, but it does the job I needed it to do. Heavily soiled laundry requires a little pretreating and handwashing prior to washing in the machine. Its a little noisier than I expected, and I have to lift the machine over the side of the tub to fully drain after use. Thankfully it's not super heavy. Love how dry the spin dryer gets the clothes. Really helpful for those who hang dry.

I love my Panda! This is a semi-automatic washing machine that requires your supervision to complete laundry. I have a Bosch Nexxt 500 series that needed several new parts and I had laundry backing up because the parts were on back order. That machine has since been repaired and is working well once more. I have learned a lot about washing in my Panda.
First of all do not place your Panda in a bathtub to do laundry. There are air intake areas that will cause the machine to malfunction if water is drawn into the motor area. Do not raise the drain hose higher than the tub of the machine. With my setup I can drain it directly into my commode and it pumps fine. It needs about a 1/2 teaspoon of liquid HE detergent to clean very well. Do not allow your control timers to get wet as this may cause machine to not work. I keep two hand towels and mop up water on the edges of the tub when I transfer my laundry to the spinner. I only fill the spinner 3/4 full and only set it to 2 1/2 minutes for the most wet items. Place your heaviest item in the spinner first. If it is a bulky item such as jeans or a corduroy shirt I only spin that item. You can tell if you need an additional minute of spin time if you are still having water flow from the drain hose when it stops you need a little extra spin. I use laundry mesh bags for delicate items. I have not had any clothing that was damaged in my machine. I do not fill it above the M for medium near the lint filter. The machine is plastic and

Definitely does its job perfectly for me. Use this with homemade laundry soap and save a ton of money! Clothes come out super clean and is much quicker than hauling to a laundromat and paying on average $4.00 to wash and dry a load. Obviously this is too small for comforters and other large items, but it has no problem washing throw blankets, full sheet sets, and two pairs of jeans at once (that was my only skepticism before purchasing). Have done dozens of loads before writing this review, and I did purchase the extended protection plan, so I plan to get my full monies worth from this awesome product!

Bought this for our small apartment. Works great and fits a lot of clothes! To reduce noise from it vibrating on the floor we bought a furniture dolly and can now move it around when needed. Also suggest placing a boot tray or rubber mat under the washer to catch any water when moving clothes from washer to spinner

This hose started leaking 60 days after purchase and this company will not help me at all. So I am now going thru steps to get some sort of resolution, no one care! so I am stuck with a machine that does not work, unless you want water all over your floors. Save your money and time PURCHASE ELSEWHERE!!!!!

It worked wonderfully for 6 months. Then the pump started making a noise. and it would stop pumping for a moment. I thought that something (a pebble) may have fallen into the drain, so I took it apart attempting to find it. When I did not find anything, I noticed that it seemed as thought water had made its way into the the inside of the pump, behind the gasket. I then turned on the separated pump for a moment, and realized that the sound was coming from the the pump itself. was a low rattling sound, but if it was in a hollow plastic box, .... there is my rattle. I am currently trying to find the proper customer support numbers.

Bought washer in December 2016, it's January 2017 and after washing 3 loads, it started to leak at the bottom.  I did not over load it, as I want to take very good care of this washer.  I like how it washes and spin dry.  It works very well in that area and does get your clothes clean.  I do believe they sent me a washer that may have sat for a very long time in a hot-to-cold-to-hot weather temperature warehouse because the plastic at the bottom around the seams was coming apart and some water was there.  Also, I saw a very small but strange rust stain on the drum in the spin side.  A new washer is on the way and I will change my view after I receive the new one and see how it works.  In the meantime, I am very irritated that I have to go through this shipping and receiving process again for the washer and have to take time out of my busy schedule to make sure I am home to receive it and then package up this other defective washer to send it back.  It's time consuming.

I use this and am quite happy with not having to lug everything I have to a laundromat.

I wish it came with casters to move it around easier if I need to. I installed my own into the plastic holes on the bottom and that worked for a while but one of the holes cracked after a while so I had to remove all of them; I imagine this is why it didn't come with casters to begin with. It still works fine but make sure it is not in the way when you start your cycle. You also will want to tape the drain hose to the hook holder or, as I experienced, it can slip out while draining and get water all over your kitchen floor. The pump works well for draining into a higher receptacle but some bit will remain in the hose and sometimes you will need the water in the tank to be at a certain level for it to start draining. I haven't figured out why it only does this sometimes. It does not do a good job with lint. I often find streaks of lint on clothes after I dry them though plenty seems to comes out of the drain. Nothing a lint roller can't fix.

It takes some getting used to. It is a much more involved process and takes more time; you will have to manually load in and set it to drain water; so you cannot just turn it on and leave. You have to figure out how much detergent to use and how much of a load it can handle at once. Too much detergent means you will be rinsing multiple times to get all the soap out and it really doesn't take much. I use Tide Free & Gentle powder an

I hate going to the expensive laundry in my apartment complex. The spinner drys clothes dryer than the commercial washing machines in the laundry. It cleans very well and if additional rinsing is required just perform another rinse cycle. I researched several models and this model met my needs the best and customer reviews were the most positive. After using it I too was very impressed. It works, it saves me time and money. Even my work clothes come out clean with a hot soak and an extra rinse cycle. It has a weight limit, but I use my luggage scale to weight the loads in a mesh laundry bag and I was pleasantly surprised that my loads were well within the suggested limits.
This little thing works great,study,does a good job of washing clothes.
Saved a lot of my quarters and lot of my trobled travel to the laundry room. Excellent machine!

LOVE LOVE LOVE This Little Machine.  So Surprising How It Works To Clean My Clothes Well.  I Must Say That I Did A lot Of Research First Before I Purchased The Panda and Thought I'd Give It a Shot.  No Disapointment Here.  Definitely Would Recommend This Product.

Wash pretty good for such cheap washer but it is only for t-shirt or jeans. try to wash baby clothes, it was horrible, everything went to dump. also it rinses bad, I need to start 3 circle to get water without bubbles from detergent. i am disappointed.

I've used it twice so far.  It will work for me.  Being by myself without a regular washer-dryer, this hooked up nicely to my kitchen faucet.  The clothes come out of the spin tumbler dry enough to hang without any water dripping at all.
so far I love it. A lot of clothes fit in this.

Love this little machine.  It is being put through the test with me.  The learning curb has come in the way of learning the right amount of detergent to use; the biggest problem I've had is lint. I hope to solve this soon with the purchase of a floating lint mesh. You're a bit more hands on with your wash but in the long run, the trade off over having to make time to go to the laundromat or laundry room is worth it. Now I can do other things while my clothes wash. I use Dr Dry portable clothing dryer to finish the process.

I live in a small one bedroom apartment with no washer, dryer hook up. This thing is a life saver, yes it's more leg work than a regular washer but it's a lot less than going to the mat. Would buy ten times over and probably pay more as well

Aside from leaking a bit, and when combined with the panda dryer?  This is the best apartment grade clothes washing combination I could hope for.  Seriously, it takes maybe (MAYBE) 2 hours a week to do my clothes + my fiances.  Does it leak a bit?  Sure, but it's powerful for the size and it fits almost anywhere.

My son bought me the Panda Model:XPB45 washer and today I tried it out. If you live in an apartment or do not have a washer and dryer hookup this is great if you don't like tugging clothes to the laundromat. It washes very good and spins almost dry.  I have not had long enough to give review on durability but will come back later for that. One likely problem in the future is the filling hose. Very thin and I see future problems staying connected to faucet. So trying to figure out how to solve this problem before I entertain it. [[ASIN:B00KY5V4M4 Panda Small Compact Portable Washing Machine(10lbs Capacity)XPB45 -Larger Size]]

The drain hose is obnoxious as all get out, but it's a useful tool overall. You just need to read the other review on here about creating an extension. I'm in the process of doing that and then it will be better, I think. As-is, the drain hose isn't long enough and likes to pop out of the sink I'm draining it into.
So far we really like it This really was more than I expected and I do not say that very often because I feel like if a product should at least live up to what it was advertised to do

Just received it today. Was excited to use. Thoroughly read the instructions and started the machine--- the agitator doesn't work. Called customer service (which is terrible by the way) did what they told me to do. Nothing. Still not working and still waiting on a response on how to fix it. I'm very unhappy and about to just return the thing.
UPDATED TO ADD--I am returning because apparently it is defective. I'm not even going to try this again.
It works amazing so far i love it !

I've had the Panda portable washer for less than one week, and already the spinner has stopped functioning. Save your money and go with a better brand/machine. I had high hopes for this little thing, and now, I have no clue what I'm going to do after shelling out all this money on this machine.
I run it x2 a week, works great so far.
Excellent product. I would definitely watch the YouTube videos prior to and after purchase just to truly understand exactly what you're receiving/expecting.
Very good product for the apartment setting. Its almost three years now. Still working great
Works well for small apartments.
IT worked great and spinner stopped working after 3rd wash. And I am single, no excess laundry. Trying to return to amazon and no box available, anyone has similar issues?

The best purchase I have made so far!  Incredibly powerful little washing machine.  Easy to set up, quiet, and gets my clothes very clean.  I'm surprised at how many clothes I can actually wash in one load.  I cannot recommend this portable washing machine enough and I wish I would have purchased it a year ago.  My only con, like most people who own this machine, is the lint trap.  It really doesn't trap much (if any) lint but you can purchase a floating lint trap or take a piece of air conditioner filter material, like I did, and insert it into the lint trap and it catches a bit more lint that way.  All in all, quality product, easy to use, the spin cycle will cut your drying time in half, and it really does a fantastic job on even the dirtiest items like reusable floor mop pads.
It's smaller than I expected. It does the laundry clean I must say. The spin dry works  really well. I only had this product for a month but I'm happy I bought it

I absolutely love this washer have tried other brands and this one works so much better.  I would recommend this to anyone that is looking for the convince of doing laundry in the apartment or any other dwelling.  Quiet, Efficient, and really cleans the laundry.

I bought this about 2 months ago to save money on laundry in my apartment building as well as making things more convenient. I am a single, young professional so I don't have a lot of laundry. I do 2 loads a week: clothes and then towels. There are some comments saying their machines seem to overheat so I just do the loads on separate days (which helps with drying space anyway). The machine is light enough that a weakling like me can easily pick it up and move it to the sink or tub. I did not have any issues with the hose fitting my sink facet. It isn't a silent machine, but I don't think it is loud or noisy. It definitely gets the clothes clean, but the lint collection is lacking. The dryer is not made to get the clothes completely dry but to wring them out--and it works great; on average it would only take about 3 hours for my clothes to be completely dry.
I Love this washing machine! I have it in the bathroom in my bedroom...its sooo convenient and easy to use and it does not take up a lot of space...
So far, this unit is everything we hoped for.  It has changed our laundry cycle.  It's not very loud, maybe like a dishwasher running. The spinner/ extractor is great.

Well,  the original one I got was stolen. However, the one I got from a friend works great! I have a family of 2, and 3 cats. I used to spend 20 bucks a week doing laundry, but now it has paid for itself in a month and a half. Just make sure that UPS makes you sign for it.
It's fine

This is one of the best purchases I have made since moving into my new apartment! I no longer have to go to the laundromat to do my laundry. The washer side of it washes my clothes just as good if not better than a normal washer and the spin dry side of it leaves my clothes dryer than when they come out of a normal washer! Only downfall I've found so far is that it sometimes leaves sleeves of your shirts twisted up with other clothes. If that is major concern you can just buy one of those bags you use in the wash for delicate clothes and problem solved.

I used this washer for 3 months and I suppose it served it's purpose along with being a major PIA. In the end I placed it in the tub so the drain hose could just lay flat and do its thing so it would stop leaking everywhere. Of course in the tub it didn't matter if it wanted to leak like a sieve, but it completely stopped once the pump had nothing to do but push the water straight out.

PROS:
• It saved me $30/week in going to the laundrymat.
• I got to mop my laundry room floor EVERYTIME I used it (before moving it to tub).
• It uses VERY VERY little detergent.
• Does clean clothes very well.
• Can complete a load of laundry in about 15-20 mins.

CONS:
• Leaks like CRAZY if the drainage hose is not flat.
• Your children will be interested in the mechanics, but will tell you they do not wish to mess up the "drain system."
• Can really wrinkle clothes in the dry spin cycle.
• Manual vague. Internet research necessary and I'm a who needs the directions person typically.

Overall, in a I'm broke my husband screwed me in the divorce, I need to replace stuff NOW to live within semi-standards I'm used to. It was great.

I will keep it -maybe...unsure if I want to pass the best guarantee of your floor will be cleaned along to someone else - I think for camping it would be awesome as long as you are using ecofriendly detergent.
This machine is very handy, in an small space. This machine doesn't hold lint very well, so you will need to buy add-on to purchase lint catcher's for inside and outside of the machine

I love my Panda Portable Washing Machine! I have a large master bedroom bathroom so fits in there very well. I put my sweaters and bras in a mesh bag for better protection because the clothes do get tangled up. Spin drains really good as well.
I bought this for my cottage.  It is exactly what I wanted.  It is very compact and efficient for my needs.  Very happy and would highly recommend this.
I love my Panda and am so thrilled to have a machine in my Condo without an expensive installation process.
Highly recommend! Fits in my bathroom, uses a T. of soap and cleans quite well. Light weight! Could improve lint filtering.

I hope there was less than one star to give this. machine and this seller.
I throw it in the garbage
Broke and leaked water EVERYWHERE. Also tore up a lot of our clothing. DO NOT BUY, manufacturer will not return your contact attempts.

The dryer spinner broke within a few weeks. Didn't get around to sending it back in time.. it's huge.  Stuck with it. Just use it to was my langerie. Such a disappointment and I paid over $150. Never again. Amazon should not sell this.

Huge thumb up for practicality. With a new baby i knew that i wouldn't be able to make ongoing trips to my building's laundry room, nor did i want to wash his clothes in those machines where I've seen people put their sneakers and rugs/mats. I especially recommend this for those planning to use cloth diapers. I wouldn't attempt that without a washing machine in your house or apartment. One negative is that the machine slides from the spin cycles' vibration, which can cause the water outlet tube to slide out of the hook that attaches it to your sink and you'll get water all over the floor. There is no complicated set up, just make sure you respect the indicated max water line to avoid a mess.

This thing is absolutely amazing.  I am a single guy in a small apartment and this is all I need for my everyday laundry.  Truthfully, I think it cleans better than my old $2,000 washer/dryer set up ... just doesn't hold as much laundry per load.  I still have to use the laundromat for my bedding, but my normal clothes and towels this thing is boss.
I'm sure it works but BUYER BEWARE, measure twice for space and note the SELLER DOES NOT RETURN. We Shendel 146$ sending this back today :(

just the two of us using this.... i do find we can fit about 4 outfits in here but that's pushing it. i think it's amazing! better than going to a laundry mat. one downside....the lint collecter is USELESS. do not mix different fabrics! buy a cheap lint roller and you'll be good to go.

We've been using this washing machine since December and so far no issue. I think it can last longer as long as you take care of it. I use it once  a week for 3-4 loads, just follow how many lbs. is allowed per load.  Most of our washing machines in the Philippines is like this, and in my experience if we load too much more than is allowed per load the motor won't stay longer (broken). When using the dryer, wait for it to fully stop spinning before opening the cover. The only downside is it's really small but it's perfect for RV's, small apartments and a new couple.

This is my second Panda replacing the first I had for three years. Durable. Reliable. Cleans very well. Use it weekly. I'M CONVINCED IT CLEANS BETTER THAN CONVENTIONAL MACHINES. Great appliance! LOVE IT!

(Accodentally left review on another model earlier).

Had this little life saver for a few months now and its still going strong. Everyone who lives in an apartment should have one of these. Saves a lot of money as we dont need to pay to wash our clothes in the apartments laundry room. Plus the wife doesnt have to lug all our clothes there.

Leaked terribly during our first use. I think customers either get a really good one, or a not so good one. Roll of the dice with this product. I wish this were a better washing machine; I wish I could say the one we got didn't leak, it would have been perfect for use in our camper.

This washer is close to worthless. I bought it in 2015 and used it for several months before donating it to goodwill. Was just going through my order history searching for something else when I saw I paid north of $200 for this. Not sure what I was thinking.

The drier stretched my shirts. I'd highly suggest testing the drier out with clothing you don't particularly like prior to using it for the rest of your laundry.
I've had it for almost a year. It's still as good as new and never stopped working from overheating or overload. A little small but will do the trick. :)
Great size for small places. Gets the job done.

This washer is so worth it! Spin dryer gets evertrying nearly dry and a you can fit much more than expected in it.
I can fit a medium load circa commercial washer into the bad boy panda without a problem!
My only complaint: lint catcher is useless. Buy one to put into your load.

I live solo in a studio with stone floors and no washer/dryer hookups. This little washer is awesome! I still go tp the laundromat for big items like comforters, etc. But for regular weekly washing for me and any friends staying over, it is perfect. One load fits about a week's worth of undies, socks, a few outfits, and maybe a towel and a pillow case. And the spin dryer works great to get the excess water out - I hang dry my clothes on a folding rack indoors and they are dry overnight usually. If I set out on a sunny day it's dry in an hour or two.

One thing that took some getting used to versus a big automatic clothes washer is that you have to be conscious and aware for the water fill up process - otherwise it will overflow and pour out. This happened once when I was not paying attention while on the phone. So be sure to set a timer! Mine fills in 5 minutes from my kitchen sink.

The other thing to get used to is multiple cycles. I work outdoors so my clothes get really dirty, so I do two cycles with soap, and two to three cycles to rinse until the water is close to completely clear. So it's a relatively involved process compared to an automatic washer. But the results are comparable, and no need to install washer/dryer hookups!

I highly recommend using this machine at a sink with a non-carpeted, sealed or stone floor below it - maybe I'm just a messy user, but seems like I always get some water on the floor when I do laundry with it.
Had it for about 7 months now it leaks from the back near the back left foot. Its really upsetting cause I used it every other day.

I am down to six months using this products. on occasion it make a motor noise when I connected it. don't know if it suppose to make this noise and when spinning the panda washer moves. Not too happy about the product currently.

After 6 months, the washer stopped working..  they returned me a new item and I paid shipping as I had not bought the warranty.  Please buy the warranty...will be a fantastic investment. I've had my new one for almost 8 mos.  works like a charm.  love this machine.  I use it everyday then hang my clothes to dry.  15 minute cycle to wash then about 5 minute I add water to the spinner to rinse out..then 3 minutes to spin.  Excellent investment,  has saved me over $40/month in laundering. I wash jeans, towels, standard bed sheets (one at a time). Plus all my other stuff.

Washes great. I have a disability and cannot leave home that often. I keep mine in my bathroom. Uses regular 110 watts. It comes with a plastic tube that I connect to my sink and water is drained to my sink too. Water drains regularly so it dosent flood the sink. Lint is an issue the filter does not work at all. I used it for 7 months and it stopped working. Could not reorder aince the product is unavailable. Purchase was reimbursed. Thank you Amazon. I will be ordering new one soon.

*****Beware******* i loved my machine! But 11 months in it has stopped working!!! Luckily it was within the 1 year warranty. WRONG!! I contacted the email i was given on amazon for manufacture warranties, they came back with some picture as a guide to fix what they think may be wrong, a conclusion they came to with my description of " it is not draining" never asked for more information. The instructions they gave me only made a mess by spilling water in the machine so i stop, i contacted them again and they said let it drain with gravity by putting the hose lower than the machine. That only drained about 1/4 of the water which is now putrid because it takes them about 3 days in between to respond. Be careful and know if you purchase it is not a warranty they offer, it is recommendation emails.

***UPDATE**** They have contacted me and offered to inspect the unit, repair it and send it back. I didn't take them up on this offer because several days have past and to water in it has become putrid and i am not to confident in about washing my clothes in a machine that may have that smell tainting my clothes. The second option was to send me a replacement unit of similar size. (my machine is was discontinued). I took them up on this one and it should delivery today. After they decided to help, things moved quickly so i updated my stars from 1 to 4.
I've had this well over a year and it's still going very strong. Had zero problems

I received my unit over a year ago and my panda story has had its ups and downs. First let me say that this is my 2nd panda unit. My first unit broke within the first month of purchase so after a few emails back and forth with Panda who asked for some videos of the problem, they replaced my unit. The first washer I had the motor that drives the agitator slowed to the point it wouldn’t even move the water around. I really do fear if this had not happened within my first month my review would be completely different.

My 2nd unit has been great with a few minor issues. The unit in the summer tends to over heat a bit and the spin cycle won’t start but if I leave the lid open it seems to allow it to cool down between cycles. The hose that connects to the sink has to be held on with a rubber band, which I should replace, but rigging it seems to work fine for now, otherwise it won’t stay attached to the sink. My previous unit’s hose didn’t need this assistance. Also, the “lint trap” is a joke. Buy a floating lint trap.. they’re cheap on amazon and work great. Completely draining the water means picking the washer up above the end of the exit hose to get it all out. We leave the unit lids ajar to keep it from getting moldy as well.

We only use about a tablespoon of detergent and fit a good amount of clothes in the washer so it’s quite economical. It’s so much better than the laundromat. The spin cycle gets a small amount of clothes dry enough that 30 min of hang

A year later the washer no longer drains the water. For $180 I expected more.
Extremely disappointed. Do not waste your money, get a real washer for $100 more.
it leaks

DEFINITELY WORTH THE MONEY!! This things already paid for its self. I bought it a while back and have been using it every week. If you are looking for a portable durable great little washing machine.. Buy this one, you wont regret it!
After a few years with this item it no longer works. I would use it once or twice a month. Now there are terrible noises when you try to use the drain feature and water leaks out.
Washes awesome!

This was a great little washer machine and saved me a small fortune in laundry expenses at my old apartments. It makes enough noise that I wouldn't use it except in a ground floor apartment, and it consumes a lot of space near the sink, but it was an excellent machine and it served me well for the entire time I could use it (and I wish I could still be using it now).

One tip: If the draining motor jams (it did a few times while I owned mine), so it begins to fail to drain, and you've got a bit of upper body strength, you can, in my experience, sometimes force the water through the jam and unblock it by lifting the entire machine, filled with water, upward at high speed. Be careful, though; this is definitely a hack, and I won't be held liable if you accidentally end up throwing a washer machine at your own head.

The Friendly Swede's stainless steel mesh tea balls, come in a set of six, and are capable of holding enough loose tea leaves, to make several servings of tea. These balls perform this task very well, and have a chain with a hook, for removing it from your cup or small kettle when the tea is ready.

For the most part, these balls are pretty nicely made. A latch securely holds the two halves of the ball in place, and the fit of the covers is nice and tight. Only tiny particles can slip through the mesh, so hopefully your tea won't have much sediment. The only negative I found was that the metal hinge on some of the balls, had a sharp edge that needed to be smoothed out. Stainless steel is easier to keep clean and resists stains, but proper cleaning is still required to prevent the buildup of any residual matter.

People like their tea at different strengths, and a set of these balls allows each person to control how much flavor they want. Well made, and easy to use, these balls could make an attractive addition to your tea service. With a diameter of about 1.5" a single ball probably does not hold enough tea to make a large potfull, but if you use two or three balls, you can probably accomplish this task.

A sample was provided for evaluation.
